fields.acceptance: An engine test in internal/run where a leaf fails both rounds of an autonomous run with its question unanswered, then Retry: the leaf gets a leaf-round marked as the retry's, a fresh builder starts at the next attempt, its skipped dependent is built after it passes and the run succeeds; a second case where it fails again ends the run failed with no new arbitration; internal/api tests show run status and the builder prompt naming the retry round with no empty decision; go test -trimpath ./internal/run/... ./internal/api/... passes
fields.statement: rhiza run resume --retry on a run that failed at a leaves step gives every failed leaf of that step one fresh round of 3 attempts, journalled as a leaf-round given by the retry rather than by a Decision, whether or not its question was answered; the step's skipped leaves reopen with it, its builder's prompt and run status name the round as the retry's, and a failure in that round is not arbitrated again
